s1.syndrome_frame: A middle-aged woman with a history of cancer presenting with a new onset of neurological symptoms and a mass lesion in the brain
salient_findings: Mass lesion in the right temporal lobe
key_facts: 46-year-old Japanese woman
History of epilepsy
History of breast cancer
Redness and swelling of the right breast
Erythema and swelling in the lower right breast
Ultrasound revealed a low-echo mass with partially unclear margins in the outer right breast
Biopsy showed invasive ductal carcinoma
High grade, ER+, PgR–, HER2 3+, Ki67 70%
Whole-body PET-CT revealed increased uptake in the right axilla, anterior mediastinum, left pleura, and liver
Received four cycles of FEC chemotherapy
Received trastuzumab plus pertuzumab with docetaxel
Achieved a clinical complete response maintained for 23 months
Developed a persistent headache two years after treatment initiation
CT and MRI of the head revealed a 30-mm mass lesion in the right temporal lobe

shortlist.label: Brain Metastasis from Breast Cancer
shortlist.why_kept: History of breast cancer and presence of a mass lesion in the brain

shortlist.label: Glioblastoma Multiforme
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of a mass lesion in the brain and new onset of neurological symptoms

shortlist.label: Cerebral Metastasis
shortlist.why_kept: Similar to brain metastasis, given the history of breast cancer

shortlist.label: Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: New onset of neurological symptoms and presence of a mass lesion in the brain

shortlist.label: Glioma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of a mass lesion in the brain and new onset of neurological symptoms

raw.rationale: The patient has a history of stage IV breast cancer with a clinical complete response maintained for 23 months, and now presents with a mass lesion in the right temporal lobe, which is consistent with metastasis from the primary breast cancer.

rejected.label: Glioblastoma Multiforme
rejected.why: No evidence of primary brain cancer symptoms or history

rejected.label: Cerebral Metastasis
rejected.why: Too general, as the patient has a known primary cancer

rejected.label: Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma
rejected.why: No evidence of lymphoma diagnosis or symptoms

rejected.label: Glioma
rejected.why: No evidence of primary brain cancer symptoms or history, and glioma is a broader category
